name: How long does a typical drywall hole repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical drywall hole repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a drywall hole repair depends on the size and complexity of the damage. Small repairs, like patching a minor puncture, might take a few hours to complete, including drying times between coats. Larger repairs involving replacing a section of drywall could extend over a day or two, especially when accounting for proper drying, texturing, and painting. We prioritize efficient work without compromising quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies based on hole size and complexity, from a few hours for small patches to a couple of days for larger sections.
